author: GamingBolt
description:
Forza Horizon is back again for another festive open world racing adventure, and this time, it takes us to Japan, a location that series fans have been desperate to visit for years. 

Forza Horizon 6 cranks things up a notch with a more expansive world filled with more to do, bombastic showcase events, and of course, a bevy of racing and driving challenges and activities to seek out and hone your skills with. As is usually the case with Horizon titles, there’s a whole let to get into here, so to easy your first drift into Forza Horizon 6, here, we’re going to go over a few beginner tips and tricks that you should keep in mind.
title: Forza Horizon 6 - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Playing

author: GamingBolt
description:
LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is nearly here, and we’re barely able to contain our excitement. But, as always, we’re being cautiously optimistic about its chances of taking the fight to the Arkham franchise, and its definitive take on Batman. We think that Gotham City has a crucial role to play in the success of a Batman story that’s looking quite expansive and ambitious. Why is that the case, though?

Well, Gotham is an unshakeable part of Batman’s mission, and the playground from which he operates. It’s also a part of his history, and the history of the many foes he’s going to face on its rooftops and streets. But wait, there’s more. Join us as we take a look at why the place from which Batman fights is almost as important as who he’s fighting, and what he’s fighting them with.
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight's Gotham City Could Be Its Real Secret Weapon

author: GamingBolt
description:
The developer has been garnering a reputation for being a benchmark in post-launch support in the weeks since Crimson Desert’s release. And we think that it's well-served, considering how the studio has been intelligent enough to identify pain points, and fix them in ways that let players enjoy changes without being forced into them.

It’s a sublime balance between player agency and developmental responses to player feedback that make for a fascinating study in how studios should deal with backlash to their releases in the future.

Why do we think so? Join us as we dive into what makes this situation as unique as it is, and why Pywel continues to be as fascinating as it is to all of us.
title: Crimson Desert Is Becoming The Weirdest Live Single Player Game of 2026
